releases.summary:
### Features
- Add app container image + Kubernetes deployment
- Add lightweight local IMAP (Dovecot) container for testing and seed script
- Add full mail client (read/write/send, drag-drop filing) — 0.3.0
- Added files: - TODO.md — planning notes (Inbox Recommendations limits/progress bar, Gmail API/OAuth support, other providers, Dashboard date default)
- Added files: - inboxAnalysis.py — CLI bridge for the MailMatrixAI-Swift app: full/stats-only inbox analysis, accept-filing, and new rules-list/rules-delete/rules-update-sender/rules-convert-domain modes for the Swift Rules screen - tests/test_inbox_analysis.py — coverage for the new inboxAnalysis.py modes
- Added files: - templates/cleanup.html — UI for domain-collapse and duplicate-address cleanup, with per-card JS actions posting to new API endpoints - templates/inbox.html — Inbox Recommendations page; auto-analyzes all current INBOX messages via /api/inbox-analyze and renders Claude filing suggestions with Accept buttons
- Added files: - cleanupRules.py — interactive optimizer for emailRules.json; finds domain-collapsible sender rules (including cross-label matches) and duplicate addresses filed under multiple labels; prompts user to confirm each change and saves on exit - tests/test_cleanup.py — 21 tests covering analysis functions, mutations, and interactive handlers with mocked input
- Added files: - README.md — project overview, setup, usage, and structure

### Other changes
- Bump electron from 38.8.6 to 39.8.5 in /electron
- Update TODO.md and bump Electron package version to 0.3.0
- Per-folder unread counts in the sidebar
- Auto-select INBOX on load; open summary previews in-app (Electron)
- Code review fixes, drop Swift-app bridge, add Electron packaging (0.2.0)
- Changed files: - pyproject.toml — bump version to 0.1.2 - commonFunctions.py, emailSummary.py — email summary reports now write a JSON stats sidecar (processed/need attention/unfiled counts + generated-at timestamp) alongside each HTML report; report stat-bar relabeled to match (Processed/Need Attention/Unfiled/Filed); summary_files() and dashboard_stats() surface these stats per report - templates/summaries.html, templates/dashboard.html — show processed/need-attention/unfiled counts and the run timestamp on both the Summaries list page and the Dashboard's per-day rows - app.py, templates/dashboard.html, static/style.css — add a Dashboard cleanup widget that only appears when there are rule optimizations to review, linking to the Cleanup screen - commonFunctions.py — build_rule_groups() now sorts domain groups by sender count (most senders first) instead of alphabetically - templates/rules.html, static/style.css — domain groups on the Rules screen are now collapsible; converting a domain rule now also detects individual sender rules for that domain under other labels and offers to delete them (avoids mail being filed to both) - commonFunctions.py — extract_body_snippet() now strips <style>/<script> block content (including truncated/unclosed blocks from byte-range-limited IMAP fetches), fixing raw CSS leaking into inbox preview text - static/style.css, templates/dashboard.html — Dashboard layout: Activity widget moved below the Email Summaries widget, which now spans the full page width as a responsive grid of day cells instead of a narrow stacked list - tests/test_app.py, tests/test_common.py, tests/test_summary.py — coverage for all of the above - TODO.md — planning notes
- Changed files: - pyproject.toml — bump version to 0.1.1 - app.py, templates/inbox.html, static/style.css — Inbox Recommendations: batch Claude calls (50 senders at a time) instead of one call over the whole inbox, run analysis as a cancellable background job with real fetch/analyze progress reporting - commonFunctions.py, templates/dashboard.html — Dashboard "Other date" input now defaults to one day before the oldest date in the 7-day summary grid - templates/rules.html, static/style.css — Rules screen now ships grouped rule data as compact JSON and renders it in scroll-loaded batches instead of the full ~3,500-row table upfront, cutting page payload from ~4.9MB to ~0.8MB; search/facet filtering and rule mutations now operate against that JSON model instead of the DOM - commonFunctions.py, app.py, templates/rules.html — converting a domain rule now detects individual sender rules for that domain under other labels and prompts to delete them too, avoiding mail being filed to both - tests/test_app.py, tests/test_common.py — coverage for all of the above - TODO.md — mark completed items
- Changed files: - commonFunctions.py — add dashboard_stats()/summary_files() (Dashboard screen), collapse_domain_rule()/resolve_duplicate_address() (Cleanup screen); consolidate get_credential()/set_credential() into a single Keychain item (one JSON blob) instead of 5 separate items, with automatic migration from the old per-key items - app.py — use the new commonFunctions helpers for dashboard/summaries/cleanup routes instead of inline duplicated logic; update .env-to-Keychain migration for the single-item credential scheme - inboxAnalysis.py — add dashboard-stats, summaries-list, and cleanup-scan/collapse-domain/resolve-duplicate modes for the Swift app's Dashboard, Summaries, and Cleanup screens - emailSummary.py — raise analyze_with_claude()'s max_tokens from 4096 to 64000 so large inboxes don't silently truncate the AI response before any JSON is emitted; surface a real error instead of failing silently - tests/conftest.py — add an autouse in-memory fake Keychain fixture so no test can reach the real macOS Keychain (previously only get_password was mocked, leaving set_password/delete_password live) - tests/test_app.py, tests/test_common.py, tests/test_inbox_analysis.py — add coverage for the above; remove now-redundant local Keychain mocks superseded by the conftest fixture

- Changed files: - templates/config.html — add X-Requested-With header to saveConfig fetch (CSRF fix); update subtitle to reflect Keychain storage - tests/test_app.py — add test verifying /api/config returns 403 without CSRF header
- Changed files: - pyproject.toml — bump requires-python to >=3.10 (python-dotenv>=1.2.2 dropped 3.9 support)
- Changed files: - commonFunctions.py — add get_credential/set_credential helpers backed by macOS Keychain (keyring); add KEYCHAIN_SERVICE constant; fall back to os.environ for backwards compatibility and tests - app.py — switch all credential reads to get_credential(); switch /api/config writes to set_credential(); add _migrate_env_to_keychain() that auto-copies .env values to Keychain on first run; remove set_key import - emailSummary.py — remove load_dotenv(); switch IMAP and Anthropic credentials to get_credential(); pass api_key explicitly to anthropic.Anthropic() - emailRulesInit.py — remove load_dotenv(); switch IMAP credentials to get_credential(); add missing credentials check with clear error - sortEmail.py — remove load_dotenv(); switch IMAP credentials to get_credential(); add missing credentials check - cleanupRules.py — remove load_dotenv() (no credentials needed; RULES_PATH remains an env override) - pyproject.toml — add keyring>=25.0 dependency - tests/test_app.py — mock keyring.get_password to return None in client fixture so tests continue using os.environ
- Changed files: - pyproject.toml — bump python-dotenv to >=1.2.2 (symlink-following CVE), pytest to >=9.0.3 (tmpdir CVE); add setuptools py-modules declaration for flat-layout compatibility
- Changed files: - app.py — CSRF before_request hook; shared rules_lock from commonFunctions; validate_email_address/validate_label on /accept and rules update routes; inbox count via SELECT response; path traversal guard on /summaries/<filename>; /inbox page and /api/inbox-analyze endpoint; M8 domain rule existence check before collapse - commonFunctions.py — export rules_lock (shared threading.Lock); validate_email_address and validate_label helpers; _LIST_RE regex for robust get_all_labels parsing; skip non-bytes folder entries - emailRulesInit.py — anchor output path to script dir; parse_headers instead of email module; lambda capture fix in fetch loop; deduplicate global address count; require output_file arg - emailSummary.py — use shared rules_lock; validate from_addr and label in accept_filing; bind local HTTP server to 127.0.0.1; anchor output dir to script dir - cleanupRules.py — move load_dotenv and path resolution into main(); anchor rules path to script dir - static/app.js — implement shared esc, escAttr, showToast, handleAccept (was empty stub); handleAccept sends X-Requested-With header - templates/dashboard.html — add X-Requested-With header to sort and generate-summary fetches; escape error text before innerHTML injection - templates/rules.html — add X-Requested-With header to all fetch calls; remove duplicate showToast; build domain rule row via imperative DOM to prevent XSS - templates/cleanup.html — rename collapseDomaim → collapseDomain; move domain/address values to data-* attributes; add X-Requested-With headers; remove duplicate showToast - templates/inbox.html — remove duplicate esc, escAttr, handleAccept (now in app.js); add X-Requested-With header to inbox-analyze fetch - tests/test_app.py — add X-Requested-With to client fixture; fix inbox_count assertion to match SELECT-based count; replace year-hardcoded date assertion with regex; remove dead no-op patch.object block; add import re - pyproject.toml — add httpx to dev dependencies

- Changed files: - emailSummary.py — run sortEmail.py as a subprocess before fetching summary data so the report reflects the post-filing state; logs a warning and continues if sort fails
- Changed files: - emailSummary.py — replace static label chip with dropdown in summary suggestions; all available labels shown with recommended one pre-selected; new labels prepended to option list; Accept reads label from select at click time - tests/test_summary.py — add tests for dropdown rendering and new-label-first ordering
- Changed files: - README.md — generalize from Gmail-only to any IMAP provider; add common server reference table
- Initial commit
